notes.title: Darkness Beauty
notes.content:
Patch notes:
[list]
[*] Double-jump introduced
[*] Shadows
[*] 300% more blood
[*] Much more visual effects
[*] When character is confused - the arrow appears over Saturday's head
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.content:
Patch 1.2:
- dozen new insurgents
- damage indicators
- ambient sound
- all tilesets were replaced
- player now reacts to nearby blocks
- voice is now louder
- improved effects of breaking tiles
- new mesh emitter at background
- maps have more decorative elements

notes.title: Voiceover and 80% off
notes.content:
[h1]Hail, noble liquidators![/h1]

+ Addition of Russian voice-over by Persona99

80% off

[h1]Have a pleasant crushing time![/h1]

notes.title: Version 1.1 Update
notes.content:
Version 1.1 Update brings forth:
[list]
[*]Defeated foes does not need to be crushed again, stages are much easier to finish now
[*]Better player controls
[*]Rattling noise removed
[*]Resolution scaling for improved performance
[/list]
